basic_info.description: Traditional 2 BR, 1 BA home located on a quiet street in the Crocker Amazon. Formal LR w/fireplace, bay window, built-in cabinets flank the fireplace. Formal DR w/coved ceiling. 2 spacious bedrooms. Kitchen with ample storage and eat-in area. Hall bath w/ tub and vanity. Large Bonus Room off the kitchen overlooks yard with closet and full bath w/shower. Huge garage has washer /dryer hookups, storage area and a separate room at the rear of the garage. Fenced in yard w/patio, close to transportation and shopping
